## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 28 июн. 2026 г. - 1 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Sam Hyland_, 1 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Signed up for 3 months, app took 50e out of my revolut account but message on the app said payment failed. So now I still have no access and they just took 50e from me. Be very careful here and read trust pilot reviews first, something I should have done"
            2. _Isidro Erazo_, 28 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "These people won't let you cancel the year subscription. looks like the company needs money"
            3. _Jack Leonard_, 20 авг. 2026 г., 2/5: "Not great for strength/hypertrophy. This app is so close to being amazing, all it needs is the ability to properly interact with the 'AI' to create proper workouts for muscle growth. Other reviews have pointed out the specific deficiencies for strength training. It is probably good if you want to lose weight (i.e. low weights, high reps, repeated for the same muscles day after day), and the UI is generally good too. It is overpriced but I get the subscription for free with my bank."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 3 мая 2026 г. - 17 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Juan Sebastián Sánchez_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Used to like the app but since the latest update is buggy af. Can't trust it for runs as it will randomly change the distances I've run or just skip intervals altogether"
            2. _Mark Campbell-Smith_, 3 мая 2026 г., 1/5: "app crashing when starting a workout. unusable at the moment"
            3. _Simone Rinaldi_, 16 июн. 2026 г., 5/5: "Ottima, app ben fatta. Anche se non dimenticatevi che per avere risultati, abbinata all'app, ci vuole COSTANZA! Edit: sono quasi alla 40esima settimana di workout e le cose vanno a meraviglia, grazie! edit. l'app va in crash al momento di iniziare il workout. app going in crash when I try to open day's workout, pls resolve"
<!--/ir-theme-->
